name: Lake Bronson State Park, Lakeside Campground
waterfront_evidence: ReserveMN facilities 758 Lakeside + 897 Lakeside Extension, search/details for every unit (night of 2027-08-15, read 2026-11-11): 'Water Front: Yes' on 37E, 38E, 39E, 40E, 41E, 45 and 46 only (none in the Extension). Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-11 at 48.7223,-96.6255 (220 m frame) with every unit's ReserveMN map point plotted: Lakeside sits on a point, and the south-edge sites (45, 42, 40E) are ~7-13 m and the east-edge sites (37E-39E) ~13-22 m from the normal-pool shore over mown grass with scattered trees and no road between (a footpath only); the west-edge sites (46-48) ~17-20 m with a brushy strip; the interior and Extension sites are inland under trees. The lake is drawn down for the dam replacement, so the edge was measured on the grass/exposed-lakebed line, and USGS ImageryOnly (full pool) puts open water on three sides of the point. Not below the dam: site 45 DEM 296 m = the lakebed DEM (Open-Meteo). Lakefront for a few sites: 37E-41E, 42, 45 and 46 (named in the note); the east-edge sites face an inlet whose fishing piers are day use.
inclusion_evidence: MN DNR Lake Bronson record spk00208 (read 2026-11-11): 'Three campgrounds offer wooded to open prairie sites'; 'Pull-Through Sites' '6 Sites' 'Located in the Lakeside Extension Campground. Sites are 90' minimum length.'; 'Sites in Lakeside and Lakeside Extension offer 20/30/50 amp service.'; RV length limit 50 ft; 'ALERT: The Lakeside and Lakeside Extension Campgrounds are closed while the Lake Bronson Dam is under reconstruction.' ReserveMN PlaceId 125: facility 758 Lakeside (47 public back-in sites, 42 electric Amp 50 $34 + 5 non-electric $24, pads 40-55 ft, plus camp host CH10) and facility 897 Lakeside Extension (13 electric Amp 50 $34, six pull-throughs, back-in pads 35-45 ft); both AllowWebBooking false while closed. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits, closed until the dam work ends (status).
note: Two adjoining loops on a point of Lake Bronson near the dam; Two Rivers, the park's third campground, about 1.5 km east, has its own entry. The lakefront sites are those on the point's south and east edges, 37E-41E, 42, 45 and 46; the rest sit among trees further back. --Claude

status.note: Closed while the DNR replaces the Lake Bronson dam (begun fall 2024, completion expected by July 2027); the lake is drawn down and closed to all use.

sites.note: Lakeside has 47 back-in sites (42 electric, pads 40-55 ft); Lakeside Extension has 13 electric sites, six of them pull-throughs the DNR puts at 90 ft minimum, which its 50-ft RV limit does not cover.

fees.note: ReserveMN: drive-in site $24 a night, electric $34.

hookups.source: DNR spk00208 overnight facilities ('Sites in Lakeside and Lakeside Extension offer 20/30/50 amp service.') + ReserveMN facilities 758 (42 electric units, Amp 50) and 897 (13 electric units, Amp 50), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: ReserveMN facility 758 (47 public units + host CH10, all Back-in, Pad Length 40-55) and 897 (50E-55E Pull-thru 45-120, 56E-62E Back-in 35-45) search/details + DNR spk00208 ('Pull-Through Sites' '6 Sites' 'Located in the Lakeside Extension Campground. Sites are 90' minimum length.'; 'RV Length Limit' '50 Feet' 'RV length limit does not apply to the pull-through sites.'; 'Normally, the Park has 67 electric sites'), read 2026-11-11
